reviewer: Codex, official institutional identity and title-scope review

decisions.reason: Official institutional announcements resolve the Goodfriend School of Business to Goodfriend College of Business and Professional Studies identity. The imported Business Administration title and actual college name do not name Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering; exclude this generic business label under current title rule rather than invent a qualifying department from individual courses.

sources.note: Entire rendered MBA programme page read. Actual Tennessee Wesleyan University Athens Tennessee identity; 30-credit MBA with eight concentrations Accounting, Finance, Healthcare Management, IT, Management, Marketing, Social Entrepreneurship, General. School of Business named for MBA guide. No exact Goodfriend College/Business Administration department identity established. Collapsed detailed course accordions not read, no qualifying Operations remit inferred.
Graduate Programs landing renders only heading and footer; no full programme cards/list visible. Not treated as complete graduate or doctoral inventory.
Academics landing renders heading/intro/footer only; no full programme or unit inventory visible. Current departmental and engineering scope incomplete.

Official 1 May 2024 announcement explicitly states Goodfriend School of Business will become Goodfriend College of Business and Professional Studies through restructuring into three colleges. Dean/parent identity confirmed, no exact effective day asserted.

Official 8 August 2024 announcement confirms actual Goodfriend College name and executive MBA, Project Management MS and Business Analytics MS delivery. Does not establish a separately named Operations department.

limitations: Exact effective day of the Goodfriend school-to-college restructuring not stated; May 2024 announced future change and August 2024 confirms actual college name.

Current title-based exclusion does not establish absence of individual Operations coursework or research, or resolve whether historical generic Business Administration source label meant a programme or department. That distinction does not change its nonmatching title. Prior doctoral scope facts remain separate and unchanged.
